text:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Pager: gateway-ingress high 5xx and increased end-to-end latency in eu-central-1. Rule: gateway/5xx_rate > 4% over 3m AND region_latency_p95 > 800ms.

Nora (oncall): I'm taking triage. Seeing 502/504s from multiple customer routes starting ~03:14 UTC. Paging @Diego @Mira.

Diego: Acknowledge. Any deploys? I don't see recent ingress code pushes. Checking traffic patterns.

Mira: Telemetry snapshot: lots of long-lived streaming connections to /v1/stream/compose. Per-shard queue skew: shard-2 Q=940, shard-5 Q=85, shard-3 Q=720. Disk IO latencies on nodes behind shard-2 spiked. KV cache miss rate jumped from 3% -> 26% across those nodes.

Nora (oncall): Hypothesis: localized cache coldness or eviction + traffic concentrated on regional shard causing runtime blocking. Immediate mitigations: 1) route overflow traffic away from shard-2 2) enable fast-fail for requests exceeding 600ms service time 3) consider restarting affected runtime container if persistent.

Diego: I'll add a temporary shard-route rule to spread traffic across shard pool. Applying via routing-config map. Running dry-run then patch.

Nora (oncall): Please do conservative steps first. Also enable a fallback model at the edge to reduce backend latency for non-critical requests.

Deploy Bot: Routing change patch initiated by Diego (03:20 UTC).

Ops-Bot: Routing patch applied to routing-config (3/3 replicas) - change: overflow_policy=spread-across-shards (03:21 UTC).

Mira: Early metrics (03:24 UTC): queue skew reduced, shard-2 Q -> 280, overall cluster Q avg -> 310. 5xx rate dropped from 5.9% -> 2.3%. But we still see intermittent 502s tied to long disk reads on node-eu-7.

Nora (oncall): I'll enable fast-fail for requests with service_time > 600ms at the proxy to protect runtime.

Diego: Command:
```
# quick toggle fast-fail on proxy
kubectl -n redwood set env deployment/gateway FAST_FAIL_MS=600
```

Deploy Bot: Gateway env updated and rollout healthy (03:27 UTC).

Mira: After fast-fail toggle (03:29 UTC): tail-error profile changed: immediate 429/499s from fast-fail for heavy clients, overall 5xx down to 0.7%. Latency tails trimmed. Customer-visible errors minimal compared to previous 5xx spike.

CS-Eli: We observed a few customer retries and some delayed responses. No data loss reported yet. I'll start a customer-impact tally and hold on notifications until postmortem.

SRE Watcher: Noting that node-eu-7 shows repeated buffered writes to local disk at high latency; potential disk health or node-level IO contention. Suggest we cordon that node and restart runtime on its pods after draining traffic.

Nora (oncall): Agreed. We'll cordon node-eu-7 and do rolling restart of pods on it. Doing it carefully to avoid extra load on others.

Diego: Steps:
1) cordon node-eu-7
2) drain pods from node with graceful timeout 60s
3) restart runtime container on each drained pod

Running now.

Deploy Bot: Node cordon initiated (03:33 UTC). Pods drained and restarted successfully (03:38 UTC).

Mira: Post-restart metrics (03:40 UTC): node-eu-7 IO latency normalized, shard queue depths stable, 5xx rate ~0.3% rolling. Looks like targeted node restart helped.

Nora (oncall): Marking incident mitigated for customer impact. We'll keep pager open for 1h for observation. Please record followups.

Diego: Triage summary & immediate followups:
- Mitigations applied: routing overflow -> spread-across-shards, gateway fast-fail @600ms, targeted cordon/restart of node-eu-7.
- Short-term impact: transient increased 429/499 fast-fail responses (intentional), 5xx reduced to baseline.
- Suspected root cause: node IO contention causing KV cache misses and runtime stalls, amplified by uneven traffic distribution (noisy shard).

Mira: Follow-up action items (owners/due dates):
- Hotfix: lower global queue alert threshold from 900 -> 500 and add per-shard skew alert (page if shard_q > 2x cluster_avg for 5m) (Diego) - PR today, deploy tomorrow AM.
- Runbook: document routing overflow command, fast-fail toggle, and safe cordon/drain flow (Nora) - draft by EOD tomorrow.
- Monitoring: add synthetic stream probe for /v1/stream/compose in eu-central-1 with 30s cadence and alert on >500ms p95 or 5xx (Mira) - deploy by EOD today.
- Infra: investigate node-eu-7 disk health and possible disk scheduling issues (SRE Watcher) - initial findings in 24h.
- CS comms: prepare a customer note once root cause narrow confirmed (CS-Eli) - draft within 2 hours after initial RCA.

Nora (oncall): Assigning owners in thread. Please paste PR links and any heap/disk profiles here. Put artifacts in /shared/incidents/2361234567/artifacts.

SRE Watcher: Uploaded disk SMART logs and iostat snapshots to /shared/incidents/2361234567/artifacts/smart_iostat.zip. Initial look: increased average await and occasional spikes; disk SMART doesn't show immediate reallocated sectors but we'll run fio to reproduce.

Mira: I'll add dashboard panels for per-shard queue_depth and disk await per node. Also creating the synthetic probe and will wire alerting.

Diego: PR created for alerting thresholds: github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/7892. Request review.

CS-Eli: I'll wait for final RCA before notifying customers. Will prepare templates now.

Incident Bot: Incident status set to mitigated (03:41 UTC). Pager will remain open for 60m for monitoring.

Nora (oncall): Thanks all. Good coordination. I'll take first pass at a short postmortem in #postmortems and link artifacts. Closing active paging here; leave follow-ups in this thread. :thumbsup:
